notes.title: Hotfix for Steam Deck
notes.content:
Despite testing thoroughly on Windows, Mac, and Linux, I didn't realize the game was unplayable on Steam Deck. It couldn't detect the correct screen size, so only the top left corner was visible.

After finally getting my hands on a Deck, I discovered the native Linux build was causing the issue. Strangely, the Windows version via Proton worked fine.

It took a lot of investigation and trial-and-error, but I eventually worked out a solution that makes the native Linux version run properly on Steam Deck, while still behaving as expected on desktop platforms.

If you previously launched Dragon Riddler on Deck, your settings might still force the wrong resolution. To reset them, tap the top left corner of the main menu and press the green confirmation button.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45585276/ee0fe97162e9b7d4c15e8e9622c32a138c321bc3.gif"]

This hotfix should install automatically, so you don't need to configure anything.



Please let me know if you find any bugs!



Cheers,

Sandor

notes.title: Hotfixes and some pleasant adjustments
notes.content:
Critically annoying bug fixed:

The primary objective of this update was to correct a bug, which prevented some boons like the Farstrider Boots from activating.

A minor annoyance was squished too:

The game failed to remember the correct display on multi-monitor setups.

Earthquake & Crystal Obelisks

Earthquake is a new game event in v0.3, and I realized that it'd be neat if the tremors actually harmed Hazard-type encounters (i.e. Obstacles and Foes), in addition to shifting everything around a bit.

Crystal Obelisks have also been added in v0.3 as a new type of Obstacles that subtly hint at the lore of the fantasy world of Dragon Riddler, but it seemed logical to me that these crystal structures should be more vulnerable to Earthquakes. Now they are.

Severe Wounds & Fierce Determination

Severe Wounds is a status effect, which was present since the first public release. When the dragon riddler or a dragon has lost 60% of their Life, the wounds have caused the loss of 1 Word Builder capacity, making it so much harder to build words.

Some players rightly pointed out that falling into an unrecoverable downward spiral is never fun, but I liked the concept of a critical health condition being reflected in the game system. Then I realized that it's a very common trope in heroic stories that the wounded character gathers their strength (perhaps for the last time), and defends and attacks even more fiercely, having nothing to lose anymore.

This brings us to a new status effect: Fierce Determination.

The Severe Wounds is now only applied to hatchling dragons. They are not yet masters of their existence, and their willpower over their bodies is not yet able to take control over.

Young dragons no longer have this weakness, but they are not yet experienced enough to find strength in a hopeless situation.

Your character, the dragon riddler, and also adult dragons (and older ones) are different. They are the primary characters in these adventures, and thus, when they only have 30% of their Life left, a hidden reserve of power activates in them, which results in +1 Word Builder capacity.

Use this power wisely, if you must, and be prepared: adult dragons will not surrender their life and treasures easily.

I hope you will enjoy these changes, and I'm looking forward to reading your thoughts, questions and comments.

Kind regards,
Sandor, the designer + developer of Dragon Riddler

notes.title: Version 0.3 Released!
notes.content:
Better dragons, a new Joker system, more turn events & encounters and boons.

NEW FEATURE: DRAGON COLORS & BETTER TACTICS
As a purely aesthetic and very apparent change, dragons now have colors. But the real improvement here is that they are now much more tactical, and when in a desperate situation, will intentionally focus on defending themselves until they can retaliate. And they will retaliate, as these are evil beasts!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45585276/758a07fc05d8640a888bdbbdf862cba6835f344b.png

Additionally, Severe Wounds is now only applied to Hatchling dragons.

There is a new status effect, called Fierce Determination, that activates when an Adult dragon or the Hero (or Heroine) loses 70% of their Life. When this happens, the character gains +1 Word Builder capacity to resist defeat as sheer willpower triumphs over the failing flesh.

NEW FEATURE: REGULAR & MERCY JOKERS
It was already possible by spending Providence to use Joker letters that could stand in for any letter.

In this update, an additional Joker system is introduced, so say hello to Regular Jokers, and keep using the Providence-controlled ones as Mercy Jokers.

Regular Joker letters are only available during Journeys. They simply cost Energy, but never contribute to word rewards, so use them only to make building a word possible.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45585276/6e3d265dfb8ba82027844c43a6fffefccac919dc.jpg

NEW TURN EVENTS
Earthquake (Journey)
Glimmerhail (Journey)
Hidden Treasure (Duel)
Cave-In (Duel)
Resurgence of Valor (Duel)
NEW ENCOUNTERS
Ogre: mighty but slow.
Fay Coin: watch the sky for signs!
Crystal Obelisks: fay dreams manifest in the waking world.
NEW BOONS

You might compare these to classic fantasy character classes: rogue, warrior, mystic. The good news is, in Dragon Riddler, your character can pursue every profession path in parallel.

Path of the Agile [color=ffffff66](2 ranks)[/color]
Ways of the Fighter [color=ffffff66](2 ranks)[/color]
Clarity of the Wise [color=ffffff66](2 ranks)[/color]
These boons favor those who craft longer words with skill, rewarding strategic wordplay and deliberate choices over mere luck.

AND MORE…
Word Builder stretch hint – hopefully it is now more apparent that you can build longer words than just what the default number of letter slots indicate.
A warning is shown in Journey when the selected letters are likely to trigger a dangerous encounter.
Dragon Sword is highlighted on the Character Sheet in duels to explain the role of those mysterious, blue circles on certain letters.
Reach no longer may decrease below 2 due to harmful turn events.
Encounters now spawn near the edge of your Reach, rather than closer.
Challenge level adjustments (e.g. encounter characteristics, boon prices).
A bunch of minor visual and usability upgrades.
Bug fixes.

notes.title: Version 0.2 Released!
notes.content:
Announcing the release of a new major feature and several changes:

NEW FEATURE: TURN EVENTS
Both Journey and Duel have their own, unique turn events, which mostly, but not always, present extra challenges for the player.

The next turn event is shown near the top left corner of the screen. Hover that area to learn more and to see what further turn events you should expect.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45585276/2f4e719f400c2df0164d7b6a0e846dd5c5e40f98.jpg
More turn events are coming soon.


NEW BOONS
Miner Kit
Watcher of Signs
A NEW FOE
Barrowmidges
CHANGES
An in-game changelog, as it is more convenient to see the updates right in the game.
Thief now attempts to flee after a successful theft.
Some Foes are now slightly stronger.
Dragons start a bit smarter.
Hall of Fame shows the total adventure time.
New Journey music: Children of the Forest by Alexander Nakarada (see Credits)
New music for the Fallen screen: Hymn of the Mountain by Alexander Nakarada (see Credits)
Configurable delay to see the dragon’s word for a longer time. This can be adjusted in the Game Settings.
Exact stat changes (for XP and Gold) are now shown as flyout numbers.
AND MORE…
Feedback forum on Steam is now directly linked from the game, so you can just post your thoughts during gameplay.
Lots of minor visual and usability upgrades.
Bug fixes.
